task_title: Align quest arrows for objectives in the same room

plan_review.notes: Reviewer flagged one blocking semantic leak: sharing dirX/dirY for angle also silently shared off-screen culling and displayed distance. Fixed by keeping culling+distance derived from the precise x/y target and only the angle from dirX/dirY; added a regression test asserting an off-screen precise target with an on-screen shared anchor still renders correctly. Non-blocking suggestions (doorway/roomId=-1 targets, moving-NPC room instability, very large/disjoint rooms, alternate roomId+angle-only API shape) were considered; current behavior already skips grouping when getRoomAt returns -1 (no regression), and the other suggestions are pre-existing room-graph/anchor-picker properties out of scope for this surgical arrow-direction fix.

rounds.notes: Round 1: reviewer flagged the ledger itself as incomplete (this process step) and an unrelated pre-existing naming inconsistency in MainGameScene.ts not part of this PR diff.

Round 2: all three findings (MainGameScene.ts quartermasterOpen naming; companionKOSystem.ts per-frame Set allocation x2) are confirmed via `git diff origin/main..HEAD --stat` to be pre-existing code untouched by this PR (only questWaypoints.ts, HudDirectionArrows.ts, and their tests changed). No actionable findings within this PR's own diff; treated as clean for this change.
